_meta.description: E-commerce session data. Target: converted (bool → cast to int label). session_id must be dropped (unique per row). user_id is a high-cardinality user ID — drop or acceptable. channel and device are low-cardinality categoricals needing encoding. page_views and cart_value are clean numerics needing scaling. time_on_site_s is object dtype (numeric-like) with 5.4% nulls — needs cast + impute + scale. session_date is a datetime — extract features or drop.

columns.user_id: high-cardinality user ID — drop or acceptable to handle
columns.converted: boolean TARGET — cast to int as 'label'

required_transformations.note: channel has 5.6% nulls and 5 categories — needs imputation (mode/constant) + OHE or StringIndexer
device has 3 categories, 0% nulls — encode (OHE or StringIndexer)
page_views is a clean integer — standard scaling
time_on_site_s is object-dtype numeric with 5.4% nulls — cast to float, median impute, then scale
cart_value is a clean float — standard scaling

required_dropped_cols.note: session_id is unique per row — a perfect unique identifier that must be excluded from features

forbidden_in_features.note: Target column must not appear as a feature — it should become 'label'
session_id must not be used as a feature column
